about: The catalogue cases of the execution findings that recording batches have taken on (ADR 0012: E3d records FX-40; E3b and E3c record their own findings). Each is cited by a recorded run of an execution fixture, or deferred with the milestone that takes it and why. TestRecordingBatchCoverage in internal/oracle enforces it.
